Complete original operation, plan and chart database rows, native receipt, install guard, run directory membership and empty linked reservations remain unchanged.
limitations: Controlled local native receipt/deployment and Kubernetes observations do not qualify retained Linux installation or actual browser/API tree controls.

Native rendering, image closure/private registry policy, fresh skipped-resource/credential proof, remaining-only selection and linked once-only execution remain open.
